title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) Complete
description: Prepares you for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam. Follows the four domains of the official exam guide (Cloud Concepts, Security and Compliance, Cloud Technology and Services, Billing, Pricing, and Support), teaches you to choose between services and spot the common traps, and links every lesson to the official AWS documentation.
benefits: Explain the AWS value proposition: the six advantages of cloud computing, Regions, Availability Zones and edge locations
Apply the six pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework
Choose a migration strategy and the right AWS migration service
Draw the line of the shared responsibility model for EC2, RDS, S3 and Lambda
Pick the right identity, encryption, network and threat-detection service for a security scenario
Choose between compute, container, serverless, storage, database, network and AI/ML services
Compare pricing models and plan costs with Budgets, Cost Explorer and the Pricing Calculator
Pick the right AWS Support plan and technical resource
